reader_corrections_and_uncertainties.finding: Reader assigns three-log explanatory concern directly to Rav. Production leaves it anonymous. No fresh אמר marks whether חיישינן is included in Rav's report or an editorial explanation; preserve uncertainty, not a confirmed false attribution.
Abaye recalls Rav Yosef's report about Rav's textual version and RYBN's scope. This is not a newly quoted direct speech by either original authority. Transmission and content must remain distinct.

Directed objection edges for juxtaposed tannaitic disagreements overstate source-explicit discourse. Retain substantive disagreement, use editorial reconstruction for chosen directional graph encoding.
מכלל is inference from R. Yehuda's reason; a support relation from premise to inference is more precise than the recorded continuation edge.

semantic_review: All 30 source cores and all 56 listed original context segments read. No additional substantive core omission confirmed beyond relation inventory. The 63 reader claims contain summaries, subclaims and objections, not a certified independent atomic denominator.
Water in Rav report and wine in supporting baraita preserved literally. No emendation or normalization. Rav Judah transmits Rav; river restriction remains anonymous.

Rav Pappa uncertainty and Rava certainty are distinct; Abaye's recollection settles a version attributed to Rav Yosef without making Rav Pappa retract. RYBN identity follows prior full name, not amora Yohanan.

Both placements of Ulla retained. No-act derivations proceed through objections, replacement and common-feature reasoning; generic asserted labels require attached argument bundle and do not mean final unchallenged proof.
Scriptural prohibition at 4b:11 differs from personal warning at 4b:6. Page-split public-announcement clause is joined. R. Yirmeya is explanatory speaker for Meir.
Payment division and individual lashes remain different conditions; Abaye and Rava offer proof routes to same outcome, not contrary sanctions.
Victim/killer-location contradiction is distinct from witness-location hazama. Rava visibility rule retains both branches. The extraordinary-vision hypothesis is rejected, its rejection accepted.

5b:1–2 attempts to explain R. Yehuda first-set rule end קשיא. Producer scope explicitly records difficulty; bare asserted position must not become settled halacha. 5b:5 proposed alignment of Reish Lakish/Yohanan with tannaim is rejected by distinct circumstances at 5b:6–7.
